signal: Onspring launched Onspring AI, a suite of AI capabilities embedded in its GRC platform powered by Anthropic's Claude models, offered as a configurable add-on module.

email.body1:
Keaton, saw Onspring launched Onspring AI, embedding Claude-powered capabilities across the GRC platform as a configurable add-on.

A launch like that usually opens more compliance and risk accounts than your Heartland team can work before they go quiet. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Onspring off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Keaton, quick follow-up for Onspring.

As Onspring AI drives new conversations, most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to convert it, so the coverage gap shows up late and the territory turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your enterprise territory needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Keaton, last bit of proof for Onspring.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other GRC software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Keaton, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority while Onspring AI rolls out, no problem at all. A product launch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise GRC motion? I will tailor it to Onspring either way.
